title: 5.4 How Many? and Some
unit_outcome: Name food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, talk about meals, ask prices and order politely at a café or market.
goal: Ask Wie viele Äpfel gibt es? and answer Es gibt drei Äpfel. / Es gibt etwas Reis.
grammar_function: Wie viele + plural + gibt es? Es gibt + number + plural / etwas + food.
speaking_outcome: Ask and say how many and how much there is.
